lines.en: Good afternoon, Rui. Your test results were sent to me this morning.
lines.pt: Boa tarde, Rui. Os resultados dos seus exames foram enviados a mim esta manhã.

lines.en: Great. When was the blood test done?
lines.pt: Ótimo. Quando foi feito o exame de sangue?

lines.en: It was done last Tuesday, and the results were checked yesterday.
lines.pt: Foi feito na terça passada, e os resultados foram conferidos ontem.

lines.en: Were my pictures taken at the same time?
lines.pt: Minhas imagens foram feitas ao mesmo tempo?

lines.en: Yes, they were taken on the same day. They were sent to the hospital by email.
lines.pt: Sim, foram feitas no mesmo dia. Foram enviadas ao hospital por e-mail.

lines.en: Was anything wrong in the tests?
No, nothing serious. Some small things were found, but they were not important.
lines.pt: Não, nada sério. Algumas coisas pequenas foram encontradas, mas não eram importantes.

lines.en: Was I given the right medicine last month?
lines.pt: Eu recebi o remédio certo no mês passado?

lines.en: Yes, you were. The medicine was given to you by Dr. Brown.
lines.pt: Sim, recebeu. O remédio foi dado a você pela Dra. Brown.

lines.en: Good. Were the results sent to my doctor too?
lines.pt: Ótimo. Os resultados foram enviados ao meu médico também?

lines.en: Yes, they were sent to her this morning, and a copy was given to you today.
lines.pt: Sim, foram enviados a ela esta manhã e uma cópia foi dada a você hoje.

facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio: The test was done. The results were sent to me. Use by para dizer quem fez.

facts.label: foi + particípio
facts.sub: Use was com um sujeito singular: The test was done. The medicine was given to you. A estrutura é was + particípio passado.

facts.label: foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use were com sujeito plural: The results were sent. The pictures were taken. A estrutura é were + particípio passado. Compare com was: um exame was done, dois exames were done.

compare.ask: The results were sent to me.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “os resultados foram enviados” e “o exame foi feito”.
compare.tip: Diga: “The results were sent to me.”
compare.us: Em inglês, o passivo no passado usa was/were + particípio: The test was done. The results were sent. Use was com singular e were com plural. Para dizer quem fez, use by: given by Dr. Brown.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The blood test was done means somebody did it.

items.why: Were sent is plural: results were sent.

items.s: We use by to say who did it: given by Dr. Brown.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The blood test was done means somebody did it. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Were sent is singular. → Falso (Were sent is plural: results were sent.)
We use by to say who did it: given by Dr. Brown. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is a quiet afternoon in Edinburgh. Rui had some tests last week. He is a bit worried about the results. He walks into the clinic office. Cal is waiting with a folder. He smiles to calm him down.
